rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a data-order change instead of another scalar sweep. The embedded current-best script now draws training rows from BOS-delimited training documents using fixed-shape sliding document windows at stride 512, closer to the doc-isolated final validation path while keeping MLX shapes stable. The model, quant-aware endgame, exact final int8+zlib evaluation, VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0 default, tokenizer/data path resolution, and export budget are otherwise preserved.
title: Doc-Window Training Stream
